HOW WE WORK

From the first conversation to ongoing collaboration,
we help keep communication moving.

/ WORKFLOW /

Starting with your needs.
Moving forward with our partners.

Sharing information and supporting communication at each stage.

  1. 01

    First conversation

    We listen to your coffee business needs and identify the points to explore together.

  2. 02

    Exploring a direction

    We consider your requirements and market conditions to find a suitable way forward.

  3. 03

    Partner discussions

    We communicate with relevant partners to explore options and information for your business.

  4. 04

    Sample review

    We help coordinate communication around samples and the quality information you need.

  5. 05

    Trade terms

    We support discussions on volume, pricing, timing and other relevant trade conditions.

  6. 06

    Progress updates

    We keep in touch with partners and share updates as the transaction progresses.

  7. 07

    Arrival follow-up

    We help confirm relevant arrival information and communicate with partners as needed.

  8. 08

    Ongoing support

    We listen to feedback and further needs, looking ahead to the next opportunity to work together.

Let’s find a way forward.

Connections and communication for your coffee business.
